raw_review_excerpt:
Round 4/3 review of the S4 focused slice plan. The artifact is well-grounded: P0 is validated with recorded grounding results, LBA1 is resolved with evidence, Phase 1 and Phase 2 tasks name concrete verify commands backed by real repo surfaces (CLI validate, bun test, plan_readiness.py). All load-bearing claims (PRD S4 row scope, Mode B contract, YAML existence, test file surfaces, current YAML deferral of design-doc intake) were verified against the directly inspected files. No freeze blockers remain. Two minor cosmetic inconsistencies (stale Current Phase field, slightly awkward ELI5 phrasing) are suppressed under anti-churn since the state JSON is the source of truth and is correct.

Issues:

- 2. [NOTE] ELI5 resume point phrasing is slightly stale

issues.title: Plan Status Controls shows stale Current Phase
issues.details: Plan Status & Controls says 'Current Phase: P0 — Grounding' but the Phase Summary table and state JSON both show P0 as Validated with P1 as the next active phase. The state JSON (source of truth) is correct.
issues.suggested_fix: Update 'Current Phase' in Plan Status & Controls to 'P1 — Scoped Implementation' on the next substantive edit. Not worth a standalone churn edit.

issues.title: ELI5 resume point phrasing is slightly stale
issues.details: ELI5 says 'Phase 0 grounding is the approved post-freeze work' but P0 is already validated. The sentence reads as if P0 is still pending. Functionally harmless since the state JSON and Phase Summary are correct.
issues.suggested_fix: Rephrase to 'Phase 1 implementation is the next post-freeze work' on the next substantive edit. Not a standalone fix.

verification_gaps: Full test execution was not performed (bun test, bun run cli validate) — commands were structurally verified to exist but not run
loader.test.ts file contents were not inspected beyond confirming file existence
Design doc body beyond line 80 was not reviewed
recommended_fixes: On next substantive plan edit, update Current Phase to P1 and adjust ELI5 resume point phrasing
workflow_compliance: Plan has all required sections: ELI5, Problem Statement, Solution Concept, Scope/Non-Goals, Architecture, Decision Options, Plan Status & Controls, Unresolved Items, Phase Summary, Phased Execution, Current Inputs, References, Doc Surface Map, Doc Sync Log
State JSON matches plan markdown for all task statuses and LBA resolution
LBA1 is the only blocker and is resolved with concrete evidence
E2E waiver is present with category and rationale
All Phase 1 and Phase 2 tasks have concrete verify commands referencing real repo surfaces
technical_reality: archon-piv-loop-codex-v2.yaml exists and its current Slice 3 boundary explicitly defers design-doc/slice-map intake — confirming the plan's gap analysis
PRD Mode B (section 6.2) defines the exact contract S4 must implement: design doc, slice map, select one slice
CLI validate workflows command exists in packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts
executor.test.ts and bundled-defaults.test.ts exist and test the claimed surfaces
State JSON snapshot_gate shows clean worktree on the correct slice branch
assumptions_to_verify: P1 implementation will modify existing YAML nodes rather than adding new workflow files — plan says this but implementation may discover a different shape
Fixture-driven executor test can exercise Mode B intake path in isolation without requiring full runtime — feasibility depends on mock coverage in executor.test.ts
verification_sufficiency: Verify commands for P1-T1 and P1-T2 cover file existence, CLI validation, and test execution — sufficient for freeze
P2-T1 uses only plan_readiness.py — appropriate for a doc-sync phase since heavy proof is already in P1
P0 verify commands used real rg/sed/ls patterns against actual files — grounding is concrete
downstream_risks: If the YAML update for Mode B requires new nodes or structural changes beyond prompt edits, bundled-defaults.generated.ts will need regeneration (bun run check:bundled) — not explicitly called out in verify commands but is covered by the existing bundled-defaults test
If executor.test.ts mock structure doesn't support multi-path workflow execution, the fixture test may need deeper refactoring than the plan anticipates
review.freeze_recommendation: Safe to freeze. Carry the remaining WARN/NOTE items as explicit follow-ups or implementation-time checks.
